answer: On the nectar roster, each identity owes one compulsory draft per epoch: a job sealed by a comet nonce, unusable for two identities. Each posts an 80-credit draft bond, refunded only after its job passes verification; a missed or copied draft burns the bond. The k-th fake identity needs a k-th job plus 80 credits, so 1,000 fakes risk 80,000 credits and 1,000 jobs, with no bulk discount. A velvet ledger records every draft for replay; reused outputs burn bonds. A rented-worker ring fails because one worker cannot finish 1,000 jobs in one epoch. An honest agent posts one bond for one job.
